ns2:section.sectionText: MONETARY ECONOMICS: This course focuses on the role of money in macroeconomics and financial systems. The course consists of two parts. The first part of the course will be devoted to the financial system and its components. The second part will concentrate on the role of central bank and monetary policy.********RESTRICTED TO ECON-LAS MAJORS. At this time, we do not plan on lifting the restriction.
